newsitem.title: CANADA: CHC Helicopter cancels repair unit sale.
newsitem.headline: CHC Helicopter cancels repair unit sale.

text.p: CHC Helicopter Corp said on Monday that it would not proceed with the previously announced sale of certain helicopter repair businesses to CHC Maintenance Trust Income Fund.

CHC Helicopter said in a statement that CHC Maintenance Trust would not be proceeding with a proposed public offering of trust units. "Given the recent extreme volatility of the capital markets, we don't believe that the sale of our repair and overhaul businesses to an income trust at this time represents the best way of achieving value for CHC shareholders," CHC chief executive Rudy Palladina said.
